summary: Inside the Gateway the conversation model profile hooks read and pin the session entry through the host's own plugin runtime API (api.runtime.agent.session getSessionEntry/listSessionEntries/patchSessionEntry and api.runtime.config.current) instead of importing the installed OpenClaw session-store SDK by file URL; the model profile contract version is read as text from its hashed chunk. No host module is imported, so OpenClaw no longer copies 21 045 files / 190 MB into the plugin capture at each restart and no second module instance exists. The Companion process and hosts without that API keep the existing loader.
reason: #126: the first agent turn after each Gateway restart took 72-90 s (S24 01/11 profile after #498: 72.4 s under plugin-generation-artifact, 41.9 s of it copying the session-store SDK graph imported by the model profile hook; 02/11 00:20 recette owner_read 90.6 s). The broader attempt #510 also shared host instances for four other loaders and installed a runtime-only extension; with it every typed tool call was refused (typed_host_admission_required) and it was reverted (#515). This change is limited to the one hook and uses the documented host API, no import at all.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the previous commit with companion-deploy.sh; the first turn after a restart pays the session-store capture again.

tests.evidence: No host API or any missing function keeps the loader; with the host API the hooks delegate with unchanged parameters and the installed SDK loader is never called (resolve + admit); without it the loader is used as before; contract chunk parsed as text (inline export, 2026.10.9 export clause, alias/unexported/duplicate refused).

tests.name: scripts/test-conversation-model-profile.cjs, scripts/test-model-flows.cjs
tests.evidence: Existing owner suites unchanged and green (451 native rows, R6 fence, lifecycle race).

capabilities.reason: Same model profile policy and storage (native SessionEntry); only the access path inside the Gateway changes.

architecture.reason: Same owner (conversationModelProfile) and same native session store, reached through the host's documented plugin runtime API; no new store, daemon, scheduler or retry.

fixtures: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/fixtures/s24-2026-11-01-plugin-capture/capture-after-498.json (S24 01/11 capture inventory and profile attribution, restored from #510)
limitations: The extension directory copy (about 4 s, 983 files twice) and @openclaw/whatsapp captures (about 22 s, OpenClaw's own) are unchanged.
api.runtime.agent.session.getSessionEntry is marked deprecated in 2026.10.9 in favour of getSessionEntryAsync; if it disappears the loader path is used again (no failure).
